The best-selling jazz album of all time is "Kind of Blue" by Miles Davis (1959) [d6][d1]. According to Newsweek, the album "remains the bestselling jazz album of all time" with "more than 4 million copies" sold and still averaging "5,000 copies a week" [d6]. RIAA data confirms this, showing Kind of Blue holds a 5x Platinum certification as of November 2019, placing it at the top of best-selling jazz albums [d1]. One low-credibility forum post (d9) claims that Bitches Brew "is often reported to have sold more," but this is contradicted by the more credible Newsweek source and RIAA certification data, making it an instance of misinformation [d9][d6][d1]. Jazzfuel also corroborates that Kind of Blue "is cited as jazz's biggest-seller" [d7].
